display.entryTitle: Escalator Space Mountain Painting Fireworks Mickey

description: Near the same escalator, a painting of Space Mountain has fireworks in its sky. In the upper left, the bursts form a Mickey.

whereToLook.scene: Near the escalator from Goofy's Kitchen, the Space Mountain painting
whereToLook.exactSpot: The upper left of the sky. Fireworks arranged as a Mickey.

bestTip: Look at the sky corner, not the mountain.
